turns.text: quick q can you make a one page printable checklist poster for the cage. scanner triage steps w/ icons, clean layout. i have like 10 min before my every other saturday ot shift starts so i need something quick i can just fill in

Happy to. A few quick things so I get the steps right: what order do you want for triage? If you're not sure, I'll draft a standard one (power/battery, charge contacts, trigger/scan test, Wi-Fi/software, swap or RMA) and you can edit. Any color preferences?

use that order. goes up at the cage so the techs and bao can follow it during their tue/thu repair training. colors, calm pls. i walked the marsh boardwalk this morning before shift so like that vibe, soft greens and blue-gray

Nice, a marsh palette works well for a calm, readable poster. Here's the design:

[Image: A portrait one-page poster on an off-white background with a soft sage green header band reading "SCANNER TRIAGE: START HERE". Below it, five large numbered rows in blue-gray rounded boxes, each with a simple line icon and a checkbox on the right:
1. [battery icon] POWER & BATTERY: Is it charged? Swap the battery and retest.
2. [plug icon] CHARGE CONTACTS: Check the cradle and contacts for dirt or bent pins.
3. [trigger icon] TRIGGER & SCAN TEST: Press the trigger and scan a test barcode.
4. [Wi-Fi icon] WI-FI & SOFTWARE: Confirm it connects and the app loads. Reboot if frozen.
5. [swap arrows icon] SWAP OR RMA: If it still fails, tag it, log it, and send it to the RMA pile.
At the bottom, a thin sage footer with blanks: "Tech: ______ Date: ______ Unit #: ______", and a small clipboard icon.]

The layout is letter size, with large type so it reads from a few feet away. Want a Spanish version of the step labels too, or a spot to write a ticket number?
ticket number line pls. no spanish on this one. ty that's gg

Done. Here's the update:

[Image: Same poster with one added line in the footer, "Ticket #: ______", beside the Tech, Date and Unit # blanks. Everything else is unchanged: sage header, blue-gray step boxes with icons, and checkboxes.]

Print it at 100% scale on letter paper. Cardstock or a sheet protector will help it survive the cage. Good luck with the shift!
